speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Thank God for Plan B.

speaker: penny
text: Howard, didn't you say you worked on the Mars Rover?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: No, you're mistaken.

speaker: penny
text: Yeah, when we first met, you said that if I went out with you, I could drive a car on Mars.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I don't know what you're talking about.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Psst! Psst!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Will you all excuse me? Leonard is subtly signalling that he'd like to talk to me in private.

speaker: penny
text: No. Yeah, I remember specifically. You started by asking if I was from Mars because my ass was out of this world.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Well, that does sound like me, but no.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Is there some problem?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Yeah. Listen, I have to kinda sneak out for a while.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: All right, goodbye.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: No, wait! If anyone asks you where I went, you don't know.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Where are you going?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I can't tell you that.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Who would ask me?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I can't tell you that, either.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: So you brought me in here to inform me that you can't tell me where you're going and you can't tell me who might ask?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Yeah, I really didn't think this through.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Leonard, a moment. If someone, and of course, we don't know who this would be, does ask where you've gone, what should I say?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: What?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I don't know. Just tell them I went to the office. No.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Are you going to the office? Then how can I say it convincingly?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Just say, Leonard went to the office.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: All right. Leonard went to(exaggerated) the office.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: What is? No, not like that! Just, Leonard went to the office.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: This would have worked out a lot better if you'd just told me you were going the office.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I'm going to the office.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: See? Why don't I believe you?
